status: Exploratory engineering assumption, not calibrated; no FE solve performed
material_assumption: Soft/annealed commercially pure nickel, 20 C, quasi-static

damage_initiation.compression_domain: Unspecified for eta<0; do not extrapolate or interpret as infinite fracture resistance
damage_initiation.low_triaxiality: Plateau below eta=1/3 is an analyst assumption; Lode/shear dependence omitted

damage_evolution.type: Linear scalar damage versus relative equivalent plastic displacement
damage_evolution.length_note: Use verified solver characteristic length; 0.15 mm is only an assumed physical band used to estimate u_full.

derivation.basis: Special Metals Table 13 bar data plus assumed onset and band; not a thin-strip test
derivation.log_scale_note: Context for choosing 0.3 only, not conversion of gauge elongation into local damage strain

hardening.extrapolation_A: Hold true stress at last exported value
hardening.extrapolation_B: sigma=sigma_end*(p/p_end)^n, n from log-log regression for p>=0.15 in exported data
hardening.note: Both extensions beyond 0.199999 are assumed and must be varied independently of damage

existing_FE.note: Different plasticity law, no damage, no triaxiality path; not used to estimate rupture force

implementation: Conceptual material proposal; no native APDL compatibility proof or material assignment
